entities.title: render.sh still asks for dummy Google and GitHub client ids
entities.summary: render.sh's header says .dev.vars needs dummy GOOGLE_/GITHUB_ client ids and secrets so the sign-in screen shows both buttons; the Worker no longer reads them.
entities.compromise: The instructions were written for Gambit's own OAuth sign-in and were not updated when sign-in moved to icelander.net's login service.
entities.cost: Someone rendering the sign-in state follows steps that do nothing: the buttons now appear only when the login service is configured (ACCOUNTS and ACCOUNTS_JWKS), so the 02-sign-in render may not show them locally.
acceptanceCriteria: render.sh says what makes the sign-in state show both buttons with the current Worker, or the scenario renders that state another way.

origin.description: The script's opening comment, against worker/auth.ts providers().
